name: Job Agent Search Bot
shortdescription: An autonomous job search agent built on Claude Code. A guided setup interview builds your candidate profile, then it runs daily — pulling live postings directly from company ATS APIs and the web, scoring each against your background, and logging the best matches to a Notion database. Fully unattended after setup, triggered on wake with no fixed schedule to babysit
technologies: Claude Code CLI, Bash, launchd, Notion (via MCP)
